name: Aswang
facts: D.O.T.S. Projector, Freezing Temperatures, Ghost Writing
lists: Strengths
Will accelerate faster with line-of-sight than any other ghost.
Can sometimes hunt with zero grace period.
Weaknesses
Cannot kill players in official hiding spots.
Slower hunt base speed.

name: Banshee
lists: Strengths
Will target a chosen player, assuming said player is inside.
Increased chance of performing a singing ghost event.
Weaknesses
Has several distinctive wails on the Parabolic Microphone and the Sound Recorder.

name: Dayan
facts: EMF Level 5, Ghost Orb, Spirit Box
lists: Strengths
Moves faster during hunts and hunts sooner when a player moves near the Dayan.
Weaknesses
Moves slower during hunts and hunts later when a player stands still near the Dayan.

name: Deildegast
facts: EMF Level 5, Ghost Writing, D.O.T.S. Projector
lists: Strengths
Moves significantly faster at the start of the contract.
Weaknesses
Becomes slower when on-site props are moved.

name: Demon
lists: Strengths
Incense is less effective, preventing a hunt for less time.
Can rarely initiate a hunt at any sanity level.
Weaknesses
Crucifix range is 50% larger than placement range indicator.

name: Deogen
facts: D.O.T.S. Projector, Ghost Writing, Spirit Box
lists: Strengths
Always knows where the player is during a hunt and moves very quickly toward its victim.
Weaknesses
Moves extremely slowly once near its victim.

name: Gallu
lists: Strengths
Becomes aggressive when protective equipment is used.
Weaknesses
Becomes less aggressive after a hunt.

name: Goryo
lists: Strengths
Can only enter a D.O.T.S. state when no player is in the same room.
Its D.O.T.S. silhouette can only be seen through a Video Camera.
Weaknesses
Cannot wander far from its room, or change favorite rooms.

name: Hantu
lists: Strengths
Lower temperatures allow the Hantu to move faster during hunts.
Weaknesses
Warmer areas slow the Hantu's movement while hunting.
Will produce freezing breath during a hunt if the fuse box is off.
Will never turn the fuse box on.

name: Jinn
lists: Strengths
Travels at a faster speed if a distant player is in line of sight while the fuse box is on.
Can occasionally drain large amounts of sanity from a nearby player.
Weaknesses
Cannot use its ability if the fuse box is off.
Will never turn the fuse box off directly.

name: Kormos
lists: Strengths
Can detect a player's footsteps from far away during a hunt and hunts earlier if players sprint nearby.
Weaknesses
Can nearly not detect the player visually.

name: Mare
facts: Ghost Writing, Ghost Orb, Spirit Box
lists: Strengths
Can hunt at a higher sanity in the dark.
Weaknesses
Has a lower hunt sanity threshold in the light.
Will occasionally turn lights off immediately after a player has turned them on.
Will never turn a light on.

name: Moroi
facts: Ghost Writing, Freezing Temperatures, Spirit Box
lists: Strengths
Moves noticeably faster at low average sanity.
Can curse players, making them lose sanity quicker than usual while in the investigation zone.
Weaknesses
Incense blinds the ghost for 50% longer during hunts.

name: Myling
lists: Strengths
Only becomes audible during a hunt at a closer range than other ghosts.
Weaknesses
Produces paranormal sounds more frequently on the Parabolic Microphone.

name: Obake
lists: Strengths
Has a chance to not leave fingerprints when interacting with things.
May cause existing fingerprints to disappear sooner than usual.
Weaknesses
Has a small chance of leaving special fingerprints.
Can briefly shapeshift into another model during a hunt.

name: Obambo
lists: Strengths
Hunts earlier and moves faster in its "aggressive" state.
Weaknesses
Hunts later and moves slower in its "calm" state.
Hunts initiated in its "aggressive" state have a reduced duration.

name: Oni
facts: D.O.T.S. Projector, EMF Level 5, Freezing Temperatures
lists: Strengths
Increased activity when players are nearby.
Weaknesses
More visible during hunts.
Cannot perform the "airball" ghost event.

name: Onryo
facts: Ghost Orb, Freezing Temperatures, Spirit Box
lists: Strengths
Will attempt to hunt after it has extinguished three flames regardless of average sanity.
Weaknesses
A nearby lit flame will prevent the Onryo from hunting, just like a crucifix.

name: Phantom
lists: Strengths
Looking at a Phantom and hearing heartbeat sounds will drain the player's sanity.
Will occasionally walk to a random player.
Weaknesses
Taking a photo of the Phantom will cause it to disappear.
Less visible during hunts.

name: Poltergeist
lists: Strengths
Capable of throwing multiple objects at once, draining sanity.
Can throw objects at high velocities.
Weaknesses
Becomes powerless with no throwables nearby.

name: Raiju
facts: D.O.T.S. Projector, EMF Level 5, Ghost Orb
lists: Strengths
Moves faster near active electronic equipment.
Weaknesses
Disrupts electronic equipment from further away when it hunts.

name: Revenant
facts: Ghost Writing, Ghost Orb, Freezing Temperatures
lists: Strengths
Moves significantly faster when a player is detected during a hunt.
Weaknesses
Moves very slowly when not detecting a player.

name: Shade
facts: Ghost Writing, EMF Level 5, Freezing Temperatures
lists: Strengths
Less likely to perform interactions.
Weaknesses
Cannot hunt if people are nearby.

name: Spirit
facts: Ghost Writing, EMF Level 5, Spirit Box
lists: Strengths
No strength.
Weaknesses
Incense is more effective, preventing a hunt for longer.

name: Thaye
facts: D.O.T.S. Projector, Ghost Writing, Ghost Orb
lists: Strengths
Moves faster during a hunt and much more active in general at the beginning of a contract.
Weaknesses
Becomes slower and less active over time when players are nearby.

name: The Mimic
facts: Fake Ghost Orbs, even with no evidence given
lists: Strengths
Can mimic the abilities and traits of other ghosts.
Weaknesses
Will present fake Ghost Orbs as secondary evidence.

name: The Twins
facts: EMF Level 5, Freezing Temperatures, Spirit Box
lists: Strengths
Either twin may start a hunt, though not at the same time.
One twin is slow, the other is fast.
Weaknesses
Will often interact with the environment at the same time but usually in different places.

name: Wraith
facts: D.O.T.S. Projector, EMF Level 5, Spirit Box
lists: Strengths
Cannot be tracked by footsteps.
Will occasionally teleport to a random player.
Weaknesses
Will not step in salt.

name: Yokai
facts: D.O.T.S. Projector, Ghost Orb, Spirit Box
lists: Strengths
Talking in the same room as a Yokai temporarily allows it to hunt at a much higher sanity threshold than usual.
Weaknesses
Can only hear players within a short radius during a hunt.

name: Yurei
facts: D.O.T.S. Projector, Ghost Orb, Freezing Temperatures
lists: Strengths
Can quickly drain sanity from nearby players.
Weaknesses
Smudging the Yurei will temporarily trap it and reduce how often it wanders.
Using its ability causes it to slam doors.
